getting-started-the-builders-on-strike.player: Hi. Interesting building you have here.

getting-started-the-builders-on-strike.speaker: Effigy
getting-started-the-builders-on-strike.text: You like it? It's simply fabulous, isn't it? A real marvel of modern design made just for my fellow alchemists and I!

getting-started-the-builders-on-strike.player: I see some builders over there. So I assume it's not yet finished.

getting-started-the-builders-on-strike.speaker: Effigy
getting-started-the-builders-on-strike.text: What a keen eye this chap has! But imagine this: a gargantuan cylinder of expert design, incorporating an inventive inner spiral walkway to multiple planes of wondrous inhabitance!

getting-started-the-builders-on-strike.speaker: Effigy
getting-started-the-builders-on-strike.text: It's going to have a use that will change this world!

getting-started-the-builders-on-strike.speaker: Effigy
getting-started-the-builders-on-strike.text: Or at least it would if we could ever get it finished.

getting-started-the-builders-on-strike.player: They don't seem to be building much.

getting-started-the-builders-on-strike.speaker: Effigy
getting-started-the-builders-on-strike.text: They've gone on strike for some petty reason about the tower being too weird. I really can't understand those men.

getting-started-the-builders-on-strike.speaker: Effigy
getting-started-the-builders-on-strike.text: Hey! Maybe you could talk to them?

getting-started-the-builders-on-strike.speaker: Effigy
getting-started-the-builders-on-strike.text: You look like a sturdy chap.

getting-started-the-builders-on-strike.speaker: Effigy
getting-started-the-builders-on-strike.text: Maybe you could finish the work?

getting-started-the-builders-on-strike.speaker: Effigy
getting-started-the-builders-on-strike.text: Come on! This is the chance of a lifetime!

getting-started-the-builders-on-strike.prompt: Start the Tower of Life quest?

steps.speaker: Effigy
steps.text: That's fantastic! Oh, I'm so pleased.

steps.player: Calm down. I'm not making any promises.

steps.speaker: Effigy
steps.text: Oh, I have a good feeling about this.

steps.speaker: Effigy
steps.text: Right.

steps.speaker: Effigy
steps.text: Go have a word with Bonafido the head builder. See if you can't get him off his backside to do some work. Oh, and I'm Effigy by the way.

steps.player: Nice to meet you Effigy, I'm [player name]. Hold on and I'll see what I can do!

steps.text: If the player has completed Making History:

steps.speaker: Effigy
steps.text: Wait a minute.

steps.speaker: Effigy
steps.text: Don't I recognise you from somewhere?

steps.speaker: Effigy
steps.text: Do you know the outpost north of Ardougne?

steps.player: Ah, yes, it's now a small museum. Jorral's looking after it. He's really making history with that place.

steps.speaker: Effigy
steps.text: Well, the King was going to make that into an alchemy lab for us, but some fool ruined our plans!

steps.player: Ah, yes. Shame. Got to go. Bye.

steps.speaker: Effigy
steps.text: Hey, wait up!

steps.player: Best I go sort out this tower. Bye.
Sorry, feeling a bit ill today.

steps.speaker: Effigy
steps.text: A bit ill?

steps.speaker: Effigy
steps.text: That's a weak excuse for a very feeble personality.

getting-started-the-builders-on-strike-t.speaker: Effigy
getting-started-the-builders-on-strike-t.text: Marvellous! So you can bring this tower to life!

getting-started-the-builders-on-strike-t.player: I'm not sure about that, but I'll take a look and see what I can do.

getting-started-the-builders-on-strike-t.speaker: Effigy
getting-started-the-builders-on-strike-t.text: Oh, what a wondrous person you are!

getting-started-the-builders-on-strike-t.player: Hi there. What is this place?

getting-started-the-builders-on-strike-t.speaker: 'Transmute' The Alchemist
getting-started-the-builders-on-strike-t.text: Ah, this be the Tower of Life! Beautiful, isn't it?

getting-started-the-builders-on-strike-t.speaker: 'Transmute' The Alchemist
getting-started-the-builders-on-strike-t.text: I question why you are so pleased about this.

getting-started-the-builders-on-strike-t.player: Well, I think it's a positive step in my career as a courageous adventurer.

getting-started-the-builders-on-strike-t.speaker: 'Currency' The Alchemist
getting-started-the-builders-on-strike-t.text: Yeah, it cost a fair bit.

getting-started-the-builders-on-strike-t.speaker: 'Currency' The Alchemist
getting-started-the-builders-on-strike-t.text: Well, I had to 'alch' a fair few belongings of my fellow alchemists to afford it.

getting-started-the-builders-on-strike-t.player: I bet they love you for that.

getting-started-the-builders-on-strike-t.speaker: 'Currency' The Alchemist
getting-started-the-builders-on-strike-t.text: Everyone loves someone that can create money.

getting-started-the-builders-on-strike-t.player: Hi. Sorry, but why do they call you 'Currency'?

getting-started-the-builders-on-strike-t.speaker: 'Currency' The Alchemist
getting-started-the-builders-on-strike-t.text: That's down to my interest in all things of monetary value.

getting-started-the-builders-on-strike-t.player: You must be pretty rich then.

getting-started-the-builders-on-strike-t.speaker: 'Currency' The Alchemist
getting-started-the-builders-on-strike-t.text: I wish. And I was, up until recently.

getting-started-the-builders-on-strike-t.speaker: 'Currency' The Alchemist
getting-started-the-builders-on-strike-t.text: This tower. Set me back a fair few million.

getting-started-the-builders-on-strike-t.player: I'll bet! It pleases you, then, to know that I have just become a builder and have been granted permission to go mess around inside.

getting-started-the-builders-on-strike-t.speaker: 'Currency' The Alchemist
getting-started-the-builders-on-strike-t.text: This is not a good day for me.

getting-started-speaking-with-bonafido-t.player: Are you Bonafido by any chance?

getting-started-speaking-with-bonafido-t.speaker: Bonafido
getting-started-speaking-with-bonafido-t.text: How can I be of assistance?

getting-started-speaking-with-bonafido-t.player: Well, I've just spoken to Effigy about this tower. He tells me he hired you to work but you're on strike. Something about an extended tea break?

getting-started-speaking-with-bonafido-t.speaker: Bonafido
getting-started-speaking-with-bonafido-t.text: Extended cup o' char? E's got it all wrong, mate. We know those alchemi-whatsits are up ta somefin' weird in building this tower, wot wiv all the machinery, and until we get some answers we're not movin a muscle.

getting-started-speaking-with-bonafido-t.player: Well, he wanted me to do something about it.
Is there no way I can convince you to continue?
Well, can I at least have a look inside the tower?

getting-started-speaking-with-bonafido-t.speaker: Bonafido
getting-started-speaking-with-bonafido-t.text: Only builders are allowed in there, like. You don't look like much ov a builder to me.

getting-started-speaking-with-bonafido-t.player: I take offence at that! Give me a chance; you may be surprised.

getting-started-speaking-with-bonafido-t.speaker: Bonafido
getting-started-speaking-with-bonafido-t.text: Okay. Come to me kitted out like a builder - hard hat, some boots, scruffy trousers and shirt - and I'll let ya try out ta be one ov us.

accessing-the-tower-obtaining-hard-hat.player: I was just wondering if you might be able to help me out with one?

steps.text: Hard hat
Try the beckon emote while wearing an item of builders' clothing!

steps.player: Wait a minute! Is there blood on this helmet?

accessing-the-tower-obtaining-hard-hat-t.speaker: 'Black-eye'
accessing-the-tower-obtaining-hard-hat-t.text: Why, thanks. Some would say as nice as the one you're wearing!

accessing-the-tower-obtaining-builder-s-.player: Hi, I'm looking to get some kit to look like one of you guys.
Anything you might be able to help me out with?
Hmmm. Has it been cleaned? I don't want some sweaty hand-me-down.
Well, that sounds good. Can I have it then?

If the player has a beer in their inventory:

steps.text: Builder's shirt
Try the beckon emote while wearing an item of builders' clothing!

If the player attempts to give a non-regular beer, such as Greenman's ale:

steps.player: Hi! How's this for some booze?

accessing-the-tower-obtaining-builder-s-.text: If the player attempts to give a beer tankard or keg of beer:
If the player attempts to give noted beer:

accessing-the-tower-obtaining-builder-s-.player: What do you do when you're not lifting logs above your head?
I can honestly say you're a very original guy.
Ah, come on. You know you want to give me free stuff.
Likely story. Sure you weren't skinny dipping?

accessing-the-tower-obtaining-builder-s-.text: If the plant has the trousers:

steps.text: Aha! You find some trousers!
Builder's trousers
Try the beckon emote while wearing an item of builders' clothing!

accessing-the-tower-obtaining-builder-s-.text: If the player doesn't have the trousers:

steps.text: Nope, nothing here.

accessing-the-tower-obtaining-builder-s-.player: Hello. I was just wondering... I don't suppose you have any spare clothing you could lend me?
Oh, but why? I could pay you!

accessing-the-tower-obtaining-builder-s-.speaker: 'No fingers'
accessing-the-tower-obtaining-builder-s-.text: Don't suppose you've seen any boots around here? Size nine, steel toed, brown leather...

accessing-the-tower-obtaining-builder-s-.player: Nope, not at all. I'd best be going. Have a nice day. Bye!

accessing-the-tower-obtaining-builder-s-.text: You attempt to pick the man's pocket.
You pick the man's pocket...and find some boots!
Try the beckon emote while wearing an item of builders' clothing!

accessing-the-tower-talking-to-bonafido-.speaker: Bonafido
accessing-the-tower-talking-to-bonafido-.text: Well, if it ain't the wannabe builder!
If not wearing the full outfit:

steps.speaker: Bonafido
steps.text: Ya don't seem to be able ta remember anyfin'... Dearie me.

steps.speaker: Bonafido
steps.text: Come back to me wearin' a hard hat, some scruffy trousers, a good top and some hard boots. Yow shud fand some around 'ere.

accessing-the-tower-talking-to-bonafido-.speaker: Bonafido
accessing-the-tower-talking-to-bonafido-.text: Like a builder frew and frew! Good job - now it's time to test your skills.

accessing-the-tower-talking-to-bonafido-.player: Okay, what do you want me to build?

accessing-the-tower-talking-to-bonafido-.speaker: Bonafido
accessing-the-tower-talking-to-bonafido-.text: Build? Hahaha, don't be a plonka!

accessing-the-tower-talking-to-bonafido-.speaker: Bonafido
accessing-the-tower-talking-to-bonafido-.text: It's not building skills that makes a true builder, you have to have the right mental attitude, yeah?

accessing-the-tower-talking-to-bonafido-.speaker: Bonafido
accessing-the-tower-talking-to-bonafido-.text: You've plenty of work to do, but you need a drink fast - what do you go for?

steps.speaker: Bonafido
steps.text: What are you? A healthy builder? Of course, not juice!

steps.speaker: Bonafido
steps.text: Bingo! Ain't nufin' betta.

steps.speaker: Bonafido
steps.text: Now, let's hear you whistle!

options.text: Do a little dance and whistle as loud as you can

steps.text: Player performs the "dance" emote
You do a little dance and whistle as loud as you can.

steps.speaker: Bonafido
steps.text: What on Gielinor are you doing? Get out of my sight.
You whistle a tune.
Player performs the "cheer" emote

steps.speaker: Bonafido
steps.text: You know, you have quite a talent there.

steps.player: Why thank you. Do you think I have what it takes to become a famous whistler?

steps.speaker: Bonafido
steps.text: No.
(Player performs "Beckon (enhanced)" emote)
You whistle for attention.

steps.speaker: Bonafido
steps.text: Wahey! Nice one. Next question.

steps.speaker: Bonafido
steps.text: What's a good sign that you need to replace your trousers?

options.text: Your legs are getting a bit cold

steps.player: Your legs are getting a bit cold?

steps.speaker: Bonafido
steps.text: Exactamondo! Glad to see you are thinking like a builder.

steps.speaker: Bonafido
steps.text: Yes, obviously if your legs are cold, you lost your trousers altogether!

steps.player: That's just what I was thinking.

steps.speaker: Bonafido
steps.text: Now the last question - what do you do if you cut your finger?

steps.speaker: Bonafido
steps.text: When was the last time you saw a builder cry?

steps.speaker: Bonafido
steps.text: Yep, that's the one!

steps.player: Suppose it could get infected then, but that'll just impress the lads all the more.

steps.speaker: Bonafido
steps.text: Exactly, you're gettin the hang of this quickly!

steps.speaker: Bonafido
steps.text: Cosmic! I canna see no reason why ya can't go in t'tower now. But be careful, there be some precarious situations in there.

steps.speaker: Bonafido
steps.text: Well, there's a pipe system, a pressure machine and a strange cage up at the top that needs finishing off. The alchemists couldn't explain what they were for.

steps.speaker: Bonafido
steps.text: Look, [player name], let me give you a bit of advice. If you want to look weak, that's the best way to go.

options.text: They're ripped and full of holes

steps.player: They're ripped and full of holes.

steps.speaker: Bonafido
steps.text: No, no, no. That's the only way they should be!

options.text: The colour is starting to fade

steps.player: The colour is starting to fade?

steps.speaker: Bonafido
steps.text: Oh no, you're really not getting the hang of this are you?

steps.speaker: Bonafido
steps.text: Ooh, get Mr Fancy Pants here and his posh wine! You're no builder.

accessing-the-tower-talking-to-bonafido-.speaker: Bonafido
accessing-the-tower-talking-to-bonafido-.text: Hi, 'Kelsew the Builder'! Been into the tower yet?

accessing-the-tower-talking-to-bonafido-.player: Not yet, I'll go when I'm ready. I'm taking my time, may have a quick cup of tea first.

unfinished-work-entering-the-tower-of-li.player: Wow, this place looks special. Best I look around for something to fix.
Heya, Bona. I had a look at the building. There's some complex machinery in there! Going to cost someone.

unfinished-work-entering-the-tower-of-li.speaker: Bonafido
unfinished-work-entering-the-tower-of-li.text: Yep, told ya so. Any idea what those alchemists are up ta?

unfinished-work-entering-the-tower-of-li.player: Well, I agree now they're up to something. The question is what...? I don't think we're going to find out much from the alchmists, though.

unfinished-work-entering-the-tower-of-li.speaker: Bonafido
unfinished-work-entering-the-tower-of-li.text: So what are you going to do?

unfinished-work-entering-the-tower-of-li.player: I shall see if I can't fix it up and see for myself what is going on. Should be able to get a good reward from them. But don't worry, I'll make sure your efforts don't go unpaid.

unfinished-work-entering-the-tower-of-li.speaker: Bonafido
unfinished-work-entering-the-tower-of-li.text: You're a star among builders, that ya are!

unfinished-work-entering-the-tower-of-li.player: Hello again, Effigy. I've had a nose around the tower. There's a lot of work to do!

unfinished-work-entering-the-tower-of-li.speaker: Effigy
unfinished-work-entering-the-tower-of-li.text: I know, I know. But think of how fantastical it will be when it is finished!

unfinished-work-entering-the-tower-of-li.player: Why fantastical? What are all those pipes and machines in there? What are you trying to do?

unfinished-work-entering-the-tower-of-li.speaker: Effigy
unfinished-work-entering-the-tower-of-li.text: The sun is shining... The birds are singing...

unfinished-work-entering-the-tower-of-li.speaker: Effigy
unfinished-work-entering-the-tower-of-li.text: Hehe. Just fix the tower. You'll soon see.

unfinished-work-entering-the-tower-of-li.player: You'd best pay me well for this.
I must say, the inside of the tower is really something to behold.

unfinished-work-entering-the-tower-of-li.speaker: 'Transmute' The Alchemist
unfinished-work-entering-the-tower-of-li.text: Why, thanks. You'll find various pieces of machinery to fix in there. You can no doubt find the materials in there, too.

unfinished-work-entering-the-tower-of-li.player: Hi, Currency. Got any spare cash?
I'm going to stop before this gets violent.

steps.text: You didn't find anything that time.
(Player performs the "No" emote)

The machine is working!

finished-work-returning-to-the-alchemist.player: Now listen, what does it all do? Why are you-

finished-work-returning-to-the-alchemist.speaker: Effigy
finished-work-returning-to-the-alchemist.text: Years of devoted work; it's complete!

finished-work-returning-to-the-alchemist.speaker: 'Transmute' The Alchemist
finished-work-returning-to-the-alchemist.text: At last! Our work is complete!

finished-work-returning-to-the-alchemist.speaker: 'Currency' The Alchemist
finished-work-returning-to-the-alchemist.text: I can almost taste the riches!

finished-work-returning-to-the-alchemist.speaker: Effigy
finished-work-returning-to-the-alchemist.text: To the top of the tower, fellow alchemists!

finished-work-returning-to-the-alchemist.player: Why does nobody listen? Best if I follow them, I suppose.

finished-work-talking-to-bonafido.player: I'm really getting annoyed with those alchemists.
Well, I completed the tower and I still have no idea what it does, and then as soon as I tell Effigy of my hard work, he doesn't say one word of thanks and legs it off into the tower!

finished-work-talking-to-bonafido.speaker: Bonafido
finished-work-talking-to-bonafido.text: Well, I'll be a rabbit in da eyes of a fox! Best ya chase after 'im then and get us our dosh! Don't you do a runner, now!

finished-work-talking-to-bonafido.player: Don't worry, I'm not about to let Effigy get away with treating us builders like this!

finished-work-going-to-the-top-of-the-to.speaker: Effigy
finished-work-going-to-the-top-of-the-to.text: It is time, my friends! The culmination of our work is complete!

finished-work-going-to-the-top-of-the-to.speaker: Effigy
finished-work-going-to-the-top-of-the-to.text: A great many years of planning and preparation has brought us here, my fellow alchemists. Now we have... The Tower of Life! We can already create gold, we can already transform matter from one thing to

finished-work-going-to-the-top-of-the-to.speaker: Effigy
finished-work-going-to-the-top-of-the-to.text: another, and now we have the ability to create life itself! We owe much to the power of Guthix, for without the life essence he left below ground, we would never have been able to bring this tower alive!

finished-work-going-to-the-top-of-the-to.speaker: Effigy
finished-work-going-to-the-top-of-the-to.text: It begins! The first day of creation!

finished-work-going-to-the-top-of-the-to.speaker: 'Transmute' The Alchemist
finished-work-going-to-the-top-of-the-to.text: It can talk! A real success.

finished-work-going-to-the-top-of-the-to.speaker: Homunculus
finished-work-going-to-the-top-of-the-to.text: Where me? Skin burn...arrgh...eyes hurt...let me go!

finished-work-going-to-the-top-of-the-to.speaker: 'Currency' The Alchemist
finished-work-going-to-the-top-of-the-to.text: Excellent, it can feel! It's self-aware. This is really a great day.

finished-work-going-to-the-top-of-the-to.speaker: Homunculus
finished-work-going-to-the-top-of-the-to.text: Whyeee cage? Argh...please help me! Graaahhh!

finished-work-going-to-the-top-of-the-to.player: This is terrible, you must do something!

finished-work-going-to-the-top-of-the-to.speaker: Effigy
finished-work-going-to-the-top-of-the-to.text: Ah, it's our helper. Thank you for fixing the tower; we will reward you greatly.

finished-work-going-to-the-top-of-the-to.player: I don't want a reward, just let it go. Can't you see it's in pain?

finished-work-going-to-the-top-of-the-to.speaker: Effigy
finished-work-going-to-the-top-of-the-to.text: Don't worry. It has no soul; it has no worth.

finished-work-going-to-the-top-of-the-to.speaker: 'Transmute' The Alchemist
finished-work-going-to-the-top-of-the-to.text: Yes, it's just an experiment in alchemy.

finished-work-going-to-the-top-of-the-to.speaker: 'Currency' The Alchemist
finished-work-going-to-the-top-of-the-to.text: The creature must be grateful for his creation.

finished-work-going-to-the-top-of-the-to.speaker: Homunculus
finished-work-going-to-the-top-of-the-to.text: You create hurt. Not fair, let me free!

finished-work-going-to-the-top-of-the-to.speaker: Effigy
finished-work-going-to-the-top-of-the-to.text: Yes, be still and quit your moaning.

finished-work-going-to-the-top-of-the-to.speaker: Effigy
finished-work-going-to-the-top-of-the-to.text: You should know your place, adventurer. This is no concern of yours now.

finished-work-going-to-the-top-of-the-to.speaker: 'Currency' The Alchemist
finished-work-going-to-the-top-of-the-to.text: You should be satisfied and leave. Then we can begin our experiments.

finished-work-going-to-the-top-of-the-to.speaker: 'Transmute' The Alchemist
finished-work-going-to-the-top-of-the-to.text: Get out of the tower before it's too late!

finished-work-going-to-the-top-of-the-to.player: They've run away. I must go confront those alchemists downstairs.

finished-work-talking-to-bonafido-again.player: You won't BELIEVE what I just saw!
That tower is... a tower of life! I just witnessed with my very own eyes the creation of an homunculus!
Homunculus! They have found a way of creating life itself, but the creature they have made is not a happy being.
Are you listening at all? This creature is very dangerous, it needs to be stopped! And fast!

finished-work-talking-to-bonafido-again.speaker: Bonafido
finished-work-talking-to-bonafido-again.text: I'm glad you've got the money sorted.

finished-work-confronting-the-alchemists.player: I can't believe what you guys have done.

finished-work-confronting-the-alchemists.speaker: 'Transmute' The Alchemist
finished-work-confronting-the-alchemists.text: Marvellous.

finished-work-confronting-the-alchemists.player: No. Scary!

finished-work-confronting-the-alchemists.speaker: 'Transmute' The Alchemist
finished-work-confronting-the-alchemists.text: That too.

finished-work-confronting-the-alchemists.player: That is one very sad creature.

finished-work-confronting-the-alchemists.speaker: 'Currency' The Alchemist
finished-work-confronting-the-alchemists.text: It'll be alright; it just needs a pat on the back.

finished-work-confronting-the-alchemists.player: Why am I suddenly glad that you're not responsible for sorting out this mess?
Effigy!

finished-work-confronting-the-alchemists.speaker: Effigy
finished-work-confronting-the-alchemists.text: I know, I know. This is a truly dangerous creation, of all proportions.

finished-work-confronting-the-alchemists.player: I hope you learn from this.

finished-work-confronting-the-alchemists.speaker: Effigy
finished-work-confronting-the-alchemists.text: I will, I will. Next time we'll use a stronger cage.

finished-work-confronting-the-alchemists.player: What?

finished-work-confronting-the-alchemists.speaker: Effigy
finished-work-confronting-the-alchemists.text: A bad joke.

finished-work-confronting-the-alchemists.player: I'll just ignore that. So, what about that Homunculus up there? You can't just leave it.

finished-work-confronting-the-alchemists.speaker: Effigy
finished-work-confronting-the-alchemists.text: Maybe you could go have a talk with it?

finished-work-confronting-the-alchemists.player: Why me? You created it!

finished-work-confronting-the-alchemists.speaker: Effigy
finished-work-confronting-the-alchemists.text: Pleeeaaase.

finished-work-confronting-the-alchemists.player: No.

finished-work-confronting-the-alchemists.speaker: Effigy
finished-work-confronting-the-alchemists.text: Pretty please with a cherry on top?

finished-work-confronting-the-alchemists.player: No way!

finished-work-confronting-the-alchemists.speaker: Effigy
finished-work-confronting-the-alchemists.text: I'll make sure you're compensated. You won't be forgotten for this!

finished-work-confronting-the-alchemists.player: Why do I get the feeling I'm doomed to go face that creature on my own?

finished-work-confronting-the-alchemists.speaker: Effigy
finished-work-confronting-the-alchemists.text: Good on you! I knew you would help us!

finished-work-confronting-the-alchemists.player: Oh well. They do say that experience teaches fools.
Hi, Effigy.

finished-work-confronting-the-alchemists.speaker: Effigy
finished-work-confronting-the-alchemists.text: Have you spoken to our wondrously fabulous creation yet?

finished-work-confronting-the-alchemists.player: I haven't spoken to it at all. Give me a chance. And please stop your overuse of adjectives.

finished-work-confronting-the-alchemists.speaker: Effigy
finished-work-confronting-the-alchemists.text: What a hideously, unforgiveable and insensitive combination of dialogue to supply to a friend!

finished-work-confronting-the-alchemists.player: I swear you'll get a knuckle sandwich sometime soon if you don't shut up.

finished-work-confronting-the-alchemists.speaker: Effigy
finished-work-confronting-the-alchemists.text: Charming.

finished-work-confronting-the-alchemists.player: I'm off to talk to the Homunculus.

finished-work-confronting-the-alchemists.speaker: 'Transmute' The Alchemist
finished-work-confronting-the-alchemists.text: Rather you than me. Can't say you look like you'll make it out alive.

finished-work-confronting-the-alchemists.player: Thanks for the support. How about saying something encouraging.

finished-work-confronting-the-alchemists.speaker: 'Transmute' The Alchemist
finished-work-confronting-the-alchemists.text: Like?

finished-work-confronting-the-alchemists.player: I don't know. How about 'You can do it!' or 'That Homunculus is in for a surprise'.

finished-work-confronting-the-alchemists.speaker: 'Transmute' The Alchemist
finished-work-confronting-the-alchemists.text: So, you want me to lie?

finished-work-confronting-the-alchemists.player: Forget it.
Okay, I'm going to go chat with the Homunculus.

finished-work-confronting-the-alchemists.speaker: 'Currency' The Alchemist
finished-work-confronting-the-alchemists.text: Very good.

finished-work-confronting-the-alchemists.speaker: 'Currency' The Alchemist
finished-work-confronting-the-alchemists.text: Could you do us a favour?

finished-work-confronting-the-alchemists.player: I probably have enough on my plate, but go ahead; what?

finished-work-confronting-the-alchemists.speaker: 'Currency' The Alchemist
finished-work-confronting-the-alchemists.text: Could you ask it a question?

finished-work-confronting-the-alchemists.player: Which is?

finished-work-confronting-the-alchemists.speaker: 'Currency' The Alchemist
finished-work-confronting-the-alchemists.text: Does it have any spare cash?

finished-work-confronting-the-alchemists.player: Let me think how I can phrase this...
No.

finished-work-confronting-the-alchemists.speaker: 'Currency' The Alchemist
finished-work-confronting-the-alchemists.text: Oh.

finished-work-freeing-the-homunculus-ret.player: It's okay, I'm here to help you.
No, honest. I helped the alchemists, but I had no idea what their plans involved.

finished-work-freeing-the-homunculus-ret.speaker: Homunculus
finished-work-freeing-the-homunculus-ret.text: Arggh, so alchemist create me now I trapped for experiements. But still I confused.

finished-work-freeing-the-homunculus-ret.speaker: Homunculus
finished-work-freeing-the-homunculus-ret.text: Me see logic, feeeel magic. A mix of the two.

finished-work-freeing-the-homunculus-ret.player: Hmmm. A creature created of logic and magic.
Don't fear. I shall fix your mind!

finished-work-freeing-the-homunculus-ret.speaker: Homunculus
finished-work-freeing-the-homunculus-ret.text: No so sure it is easy to do. No one canna 'elp. Arghhh.
You must now make sense of the Homunculus's mind. Force him to either follow the line of logic or the line of magic.

finished-work-freeing-the-homunculus-ret.player: You tell me that you're confused, so ask me some questions!

finished-work-freeing-the-homunculus-ret.text: Choosing any one of the three options will give three new options in the same order and change the Homunculus' sanity meter. They will eventually loop.

steps.prompt: How can I make fire appear at my fingertips?

options.text: Get some logs and a tinderbox.
With the aid of 5 fire runes.
That's impossible! No one can do that!
Not too sure, I've never seen it happen.
With the help of the magical dragonstones!
By ignition of gas in their belly as they exhale.

steps.prompt: What do people do, day-in, day-out?
What could I do with unwanted bones?

options.text: I'd like to think you wouldn't be carrying bones around.
Turn them into bananas or peaches!

steps.prompt: What's the best way to travel?

options.text: I'm not really much of a traveller, sorry.
Run, run as fast as you can.
Depends where you are headed, but teleport spells are a safe bet.

steps.prompt: I hear people whisper of potions...

options.text: Yes, you can make magic potions to boost your skills.
People mix together ingredients in vials. The nutrients will help you.
By harnessing the power of the gods!
Take some essence to an altar and use a talisman.

steps.prompt: Can people move things with the power of the mind?

options.text: Perhaps. I've never seen it myself, though.
Yep, you can use the Telekinetic Grab spell.
Sure. Use your brain to tell someone to move it!
It's a simple case of combining materials.

steps.prompt: Explain those flashing sparks that scared the alchemists.

options.text: You have special powers - no surprise seeing how you were created.
Coincidence - there is a lot of loose metal around.
Yeah, they were cool! Nice one.

steps.prompt: I want to learn more - what should I study?

options.text: Try some Mining followed by Smithing.
That's up to you; depends on what you find interesting.

steps.prompt: If I can reach out far enough I can grab the sun.

options.text: Don't be silly! You'd get burnt!
Can't see why not, anything is possible.
Well the sun is not actually there, it's where it used to be!

steps.prompt: Am I a creature of magic or a creature of logic?

options.text: Everything has a reason, even if you don't know what it is.
Your very existense speaks of mystical forces.
I'm too laid back to really care, mate.

finished-work-freeing-the-homunculus-ret.text: When the Homunculus' mind is fixed:

finished-work-freeing-the-homunculus-ret.speaker: Homunculus
finished-work-freeing-the-homunculus-ret.text: That it! Make sense now, thank you!

finished-work-freeing-the-homunculus-ret.player: I decided to root for magic.

finished-work-freeing-the-homunculus-ret.speaker: Homunculus
finished-work-freeing-the-homunculus-ret.text: No does matter which you chose. Me needed organise my thoughts. I see there is truth in both.

finished-work-freeing-the-homunculus-ret.speaker: Homunculus
finished-work-freeing-the-homunculus-ret.text: Now we go scare alchemies - they have been wrong to do this! Although I have life, they mustn't go about this again.

finished-work-freeing-the-homunculus-ret.player: Sounds like a good plan. Can you get out of that cage?

finished-work-freeing-the-homunculus-ret.speaker: Homunculus
finished-work-freeing-the-homunculus-ret.text: Easy. You run down and I watching from here. I surprise right moment.

finished-work-freeing-the-homunculus-tal.speaker: Homunculus
finished-work-freeing-the-homunculus-tal.text: Better. You been mine angel. I now have the understanding I need.

finished-work-freeing-the-homunculus-tal.speaker: Homunculus
finished-work-freeing-the-homunculus-tal.text: Please, alchemists you speak, me appear to surprise.

finished-work-freeing-the-homunculus-tal.player: I'm not sure I understand, but okay, I will go have a word with them.

finished-work-freeing-the-homunculus-tal.speaker: Bonafido
finished-work-freeing-the-homunculus-tal.text: Looks like we're out of a job then.

finished-work-freeing-the-homunculus-tal.player: Oh, I wouldn't worry about it. There are frequently new buildings required around Gielinor. I'm sure your services will be called upon again.

finished-work-freeing-the-homunculus-sca.player: Well, I've sat down and had a good chat with the Homunculus.
The Homunculus is a bit better off now.

finished-work-freeing-the-homunculus-sca.speaker: 'Currency' The Alchemist
finished-work-freeing-the-homunculus-sca.text: Excellent. So we can go back in.

finished-work-freeing-the-homunculus-eff.player: Effigy, I need a word with you.

finished-work-freeing-the-homunculus-eff.speaker: Effigy
finished-work-freeing-the-homunculus-eff.text: You set it free. Oh, please don't hurt me!

finished-work-freeing-the-homunculus-eff.speaker: Homunculus
finished-work-freeing-the-homunculus-eff.text: Me not hurt. Now tell. What you plans? What you do with me?

finished-work-freeing-the-homunculus-eff.speaker: Effigy
finished-work-freeing-the-homunculus-eff.text: Please, we just wanted to experiment. We wanted to create life. There's a dungeon under the tower. Long ago we found a strange source of energy that we believe was left behind by the great Guthix. He used to

finished-work-freeing-the-homunculus-eff.speaker: Effigy
finished-work-freeing-the-homunculus-eff.text: create life with such ease. We realised we should be able to use this powerful substance, but we needed to bring together our magic along with the logical construction of the builders. It seemed through our experiments that

finished-work-freeing-the-homunculus-eff.speaker: Effigy
finished-work-freeing-the-homunculus-eff.text: even magic needs a certain level of rules and laws to work.

finished-work-freeing-the-homunculus-eff.speaker: Homunculus
finished-work-freeing-the-homunculus-eff.text: Bad play with. Naughty men. Go! Go, never return!

finished-work-freeing-the-homunculus-eff.speaker: Homunculus
finished-work-freeing-the-homunculus-eff.text: Me look dungeon, [player name]. Please meet there.

finished-work-finishing-off-talking-to-t.speaker: Homunculus
finished-work-finishing-off-talking-to-t.text: Me do know. Pleased you rescue.

finished-work-finishing-off-talking-to-t.player: My pleasure. So what is this place?

finished-work-finishing-off-talking-to-t.speaker: Homunculus
finished-work-finishing-off-talking-to-t.text: They use essence of Guthix power. Create tower pump this from ground. Make me with godly power. Dangerous.

finished-work-finishing-off-talking-to-t.player: Oh dear, but you're okay now. You have this place to reside in.

finished-work-finishing-off-talking-to-t.speaker: Homunculus
finished-work-finishing-off-talking-to-t.text: Thrank you. For reward you speak me, I makes monsters.
